Hymn 24: God Bless Our Prophet Dear
Time Signature: 3/4
Musical Key: F Major
Composer: H. A. Tuckett
Lyricist/Text Author: Bernard Snow
Category: Restoration

This is hymn number 24 titled "God Bless Our Prophet Dear" from the Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints hymnbook. 
It is written in F Major with a 3/4 time signature. 
The music was composed by H. A. Tuckett and the lyrics were written by Bernard Snow.
This hymn is categorized under: Restoration.
